identity_reason: it is a Popover and an IconButton with rows lit like menu rows, so only the unread mark is its own
concept: A bell that opens notices grouped by day, unread ones with a dot and the word New, and a count on the bell.

pop.why: the popover is wider than the default so a notice fits on two lines

panel.why: the heading and the groups stack and scroll inside the popover

head.why: the heading and Mark all as read share a row

title.why: the heading is semibold at the emphasis size

group.why: each day stacks its heading and its rows

heading.why: the day heading is secondary at caption size

list.why: the rows stack with no gap so their highlights touch

row.why: each notice is a 44px button lit under the pointer like a menu row

leading.why: an avatar or glyph keeps its own size at the row start

text.why: the title, body and time stack and take the free width

line.why: the title is at label size and wraps instead of spilling

unread.why: an unread notice sets its title semibold so it stands out by weight

body.why: the body is secondary at label size under the title of the notice

time.why: the time is secondary at caption size at the foot of the notice

new.why: an unread notice adds the word New before its time

dot.why: an unread notice carries a dot in the loud solid beside the word New

bell.why: the bell is drawn with the ring stroke at icon size

badge.why: the count sits on the bell in the loud solid and caps at 9 plus

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

hover.why: a notice takes the quiet surface under the pointer

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard

background-color.why: the row highlight fades in on the hover ease instead of flashing
